module: Ubuntu 16.04 Kernel Crypto API Cryptographic Module
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and installed, initialized and configured as specified in Sections 9.1 of the Security Policy.
description: The Ubuntu 16.04 Kernel Crypto API module is a software module running as part of the operating system kernel that provides general purpose cryptographic services.
tested_configurations: Ubuntu 16.04 LTS 64-bit running on Supermicro SYS-5018R-WR with Intel Xeon E5 with PAA
Ubuntu 16.04 LTS 64-bit running on Supermicro SYS-5018R-WR with Intel Xeon E5 without PAA (single-user mode)
allowed_algorithms: NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 149 bits of encryption strength)
